Priya Rao: opened PR to correct the "Troubleshooting > Error reference" section. Found misleading example that suggests parsing partial JSON from streams after a 429 — risky. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9001
Noah Kim: thanks. Can you add a small decision note: when to rejoin a stream (if resumable/idempotent) vs shortcircuit/fallback? People keep assuming resume is always safe.
Priya Rao: added a decision table and both a curl repro + compact Python v2 snippet. Curl repro to simulate network cut then server-side 429:
Priya Rao: ```bash
# simulate interrupted stream then a delayed 429
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small-1","input":"<very long prompt>"}'
# kill socket after a few tokens to mimic a client disconnect
```
Evelyn Brooks: love the table. For snippet show `retry_policy` + trim-to-last-N-tokens and prefer prefix-caching advice. Here's a compact Python example I added:
Evelyn Brooks: ```python
# pseudo v2 client
resp = client.responses.stream(model="rwd-small-1", input=trim_to_tail(prompt, 2048))
try:
  for chunk in resp:
    display(chunk)
except StreamError as e:
  if getattr(e, "status_code", None) == 429:
    # if operation is idempotent and have resume token -> rejoin
    # otherwise: apply exponential backoff, trim prompt, or switch model variant
    backoff_expand(attempts=1)
    retry_with_trim()
```
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9001  build queued
Noah Kim: CI flagged a broken anchor in samples/errref/truncation.md. I fixed the anchor to `#rejoin-vs-shortcircuit` and updated links across the repo.
Priya Rao: also added a short note under Context limits: check response metadata for `truncated` or `partial` flags instead of assuming full fidelity.
Evelyn Brooks: ran the curl repro in staging, reproduced the stream->429 behavior. Added an explicit recommendation: prefer checking numeric status over parsing partial chunk content.
Noah Kim: lint and link fixes pushed, CI now green :white_check_mark:
Priya Rao: merging after squash. I'll add a changelog line: "Docs: clarify stream 429 behavior, add rejoin vs shortcircuit guidance and SDK snippets".
